digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today closed with a clear Sprint 17 priority decision and approval of the client communications compliance framework, while Amazon Connect UAT still needs a disciplined recovery plan before the next round. The remaining carry-forward work is concentrated around UAT, portfolio prioritization, access questions, and dependency ownership.

items.label: Secured approval for the client communications compliance framework
items.detail: Lucia confirmed approval of the charter after Laura's follow-up.

items.label: Scheduled the PC Toggl alignment touchpoint
items.detail: Jean sent the meeting invite to align the project coordinators on correct Toggl use, and Armando and Astrid accepted.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect UAT recovery plan
items.detail: Tester feedback still shows unresolved call routing, delayed Command Center visibility, a nonworking supervisor monitor, disabled transfers, unclear issue ownership, and no reliable ready-to-retest loop. Assign owners, confirm retest status, and lock the recovery plan before Round II begins September 8.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: Rank the five Quality requests by business impact and set one intake path that fits available PM and PE capacity.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Number-ownership documents have moved forward, but the production list and provisioning guidance still need to be finalized so they do not become Round II blockers.

items.label: Update the Sprint 17 plan and clear the remaining DNC scope question
items.detail: Biographical Deadlines was deferred to the next sprint and NTA entered Sprint 17. Record those changes, then resolve the DNC scope expansion that is still awaiting Frank's response.

items.label: Limpiar Asana con el spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Reconcile Armando's spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and appropriate permission for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: Confirm the Revenue Cloud owner, bring Deepak and Tim into the Sales Cloud work, secure an invoice record in sandbox, and set firm due dates.

items.label: Close out the Staff Aug document question
items.detail: Jason said the broad sharing invitation was sent by accident and should be ignored. Confirm Licelot has the intended access path and a clear answer on what action, if any, remains.

items.label: SMS Automation Optimization weekly status was canceled
items.detail: Laura canceled the session because of the firmwide meeting and said the next discussion will focus on the appointment reminder campaign on Thursday.

items.label: Biographical Deadlines will wait until the next sprint
items.detail: Sara confirmed the work will be held for the next sprint after reviewing Sprint 17 capacity; Mar confirmed NTA is in Sprint 17.

items.label: 10:30 AM - SVC standup, followed by Spanish self-review training
items.detail: The standup runs 10:30-11:00 AM, and the Spanish training runs 11:00 AM-noon.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the two-hour block for Amazon recovery follow-through, Sprint 17 updates, and the remaining access decisions.

items.label: 2:00 PM - EPMO Team Meeting conflicts with English self-review training
items.detail: The Spanish morning session avoids the 2:00 PM collision if training still needs to be completed.

items.label: 3:00-5:00 PM - Thiago, Legal, CoE, and Sara follow-through
items.detail: The Thiago 1:1 starts at 3:00 PM, Legal portfolio review at 3:30 PM, and the 4:00 PM CoE touchpoint overlaps meeting-prep focus time before the 4:30 PM Sara 1:1.
